@@ -66,20 +66,20 @@ install_packages() {
 
 	dnf | yum)
 		if [ "$ID" = "fedora" ]; then
-			$SUDO dnf -y install $PACKAGES neovim exa
+			$SUDO $PKG_MANAGER -y install $PACKAGES neovim exa
 		elif [ "$ID" = "almalinux" ]; then
-			$SUDO dnf -y install epel-release
+			$SUDO $PKG_MANAGER -y install epel-release
 			PACKAGES=$(echo $PACKAGES | sed -r -e 's/\<ripgrep\>//')
-			$SUDO dnf -y install $PACKAGES vim
+			$SUDO $PKG_MANAGER -y install $PACKAGES vim
 		elif [ "$ID" = "centos" ]; then
-			$SUDO dnf -y install epel-release
+			$SUDO $PKG_MANAGER -y install epel-release
 			PACKAGES=$(echo $PACKAGES | sed -r -e 's/\<ripgrep\>//')
-			$SUDO dnf -y install $PACKAGES vim
+			$SUDO $PKG_MANAGER -y install $PACKAGES vim
 	  elif [ "$ID" = "photon" ]; then
 			PACKAGES=$(echo $PACKAGES | sed -r -e 's/\<ripgrep\>|\<bash-completion\>//')
-			$SUDO dnf -y install $PACKAGES vim
+			$SUDO $PKG_MANAGER -y install $PACKAGES vim
 		else
-			$SUDO dnf -y install $PACKAGES vim
+			$SUDO $PKG_MANAGER -y install $PACKAGES vim
 		fi
 		;;
